title: Introduce Econ-Orbiter batch-shape-classifier and quant-compat telemetry
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: large tenant mix shows divergent batch shapes that cause suboptimal batching and quant fallback thrashing. This PR adds a light-weight batch-shape-classifier that tags incoming request streams with a compact signature, feeds signals into the econ-orbiter to select safe quant profiles, and emits new telemetry to validate unit-econ impact. Goals: 1) reduce quant fallback oscillation for mid-size sequences, 2) pick more cost-effective quant profiles earlier without increasing tail latency, 3) provide observability hooks for post-merge validation and automatic rollback. Changes are conservative by default: classifier runs at admission and can be toggled per-tenant; quant profile selection only changes when the confidence score crosses a high threshold and when KV cache hit ratios are stable. Checklist: - [x] implement batch-shape-classifier (fast, <200ns per request path) - [x] integrate econ-orbiter decision hook with quant profile selector - [x] add toggle + tenant-scoped opt-in config - [x] telemetry: econ_signals, batch_shape_hist, quant_compat_events - [x] unit + integration tests for classifier + policy decision - [x] perf benchmarks (synthetic) and safety gating in CI - [x] docs: admin toggle + operator runbook How it works (short): classifier computes a 32-bit signature based on token-length histogram, request metadata, and prefix stability heuristics; signature is compared to a lightweight in-memory sketch to classify as 'steady', 'bursty', or 'fragmented'. The econ-orbiter consumes the label and historic cost/latency counters to pick a quant profile from the tenant's allowed set. A safety gate enforces TTL-based probation and forces reversion if tail p99 increases >10% over baseline. Rollout plan: feature flagged off by default; staged rollout to internal tenants, then opt-in beta for self-serve tenants, monitor econ_signals and quant_compat_events for 72 hours each stage. Related: ENG-3921 (batch telemetry), SUP-1212 (customer incident that motivated classifier).
commits_summary: c1a2d1a add batch-shape-classifier implementation; b3f9e2b integrate econ-orbiter hook and high-confidence policy; d4e7f8c add telemetry counters and prometheus metrics; e9a1b4f tests: unit + integration + perf harness; f0b2c3d docs: admin toggle and runbook
review_thread: Miles Chen (reviewer): Can the classifier state be sharded per-GPU to avoid hot locks? Suggest using per-worker ring buffer and eventual merge.
Ava Patel (author): Good point — switched to per-worker ring buffer and merged metrics via async flush. See batch_shape_classifier.go line 112 for comment.
Priya Nair (reviewer): We should avoid making quant changes for tenants with <10k requests/day in this release. Please add tenant-threshold check.
Ava Patel (author): Added tenant-min-traffic check and flagged in config (deploy/feature_flags/feature_flags.yaml).
Jonah Reed (reviewer): CI flagged a perf regression on a synthetic warmup; test harness shows +2% CPU in one scenario. Can we add an opt-out switch at admission?
Ava Patel (author): Added early-exit fast-path when classifier confidence < 0.25 to avoid additional CPU on cold paths. Reran benchmarks — perf regression resolved.
Miles Chen (approver): LGTM after the perf run and tenant-threshold check. Approving for merge.
release_notes:
- Add batch-shape-classifier to tag request patterns and enable safer quant profile selection.
- New telemetry: econ_signals, batch_shape_hist, quant_compat_events.
- Feature-flagged rollout with tenant opt-in and operator runbook.
- Safety gates: tenant-min-traffic and confidence thresholds to prevent oscillation.
